title: Cancellation Reasons in Appointment Series Same-Day Cancellation Fees
content:
**Desk guidance — Patient Services Center.** The reason recorded on a same-day cancellation bears on the same-day cancellation fee of an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The same-day reason share is 50 percent where the reason recorded on the cancellation is patient illness or family emergency, 80 percent where it is transportation or weather, and 100 percent for any other reason. The share is read as a percentage of the same-day basis and multiplies it.

**Which reason.** The reason recorded on the most recent cancellation on the series that carries no minutes late, the one with the latest appointment date.

**By recorded reason.**

- patient illness — 50 percent
- family emergency — 50 percent
- transportation — 80 percent
- weather — 80 percent
- any other reason — 100 percent

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A same-day cancellation recorded for family emergency on a same-day basis of USD 45.00: 50 percent of USD 45.00 is USD 22.50.
